PullRequest.Title: Add PatchBased02UnifiedEagerness prompt strategy
PullRequest.Body:
Add the standalone `PatchBased02UnifiedEagerness` prompting strategy -- clone of `PatchBased02Unified` with `eagernessPrompt: "aggressionHighLow"`.

Depends on https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/333606

Scenarios.Scenario: Discover and select an inline-edits model whose remote or configured prompt strategy is PatchBased02UnifiedEagerness
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Existing model-list/config observables validate the strategy, choose a model, and apply a constant-sized strategy override before provider configuration can reflect the selection. The diff adds only an enum value and fixed object merges; it does not add blocking work to model discovery.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Fetch the proxy /models list that supplies NES model capabilities
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Existing model-list fetch/update cadence; the diff does not issue or repeat the fetch, and each received list is processed once by the existing observable path.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same /models boundary and O(number of returned models) filtering occurred; this strategy string was simply not recognized.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The fetched list may determine the selected model, but the changed strategy handling runs only after the boundary completes.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of models in the existing fetched/configured list; the added strategy contributes constant work per matching model and no additional pass.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Existing reactive model-list updates and model-selection scheduling are unchanged; the diff adds no task, queue, or parallel operation.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The model list remains owned by the existing proxy-model observable. Strategy application creates small merged objects on reads and does not add a cache, cache key, or retained entry.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: call sites show the enum is used to accept existing model metadata and apply a fixed configuration object only.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The frequency of proxy model refreshes is outside the changed code, but no changed mechanism increases it.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression: model discovery has the same boundary count and list scaling as before.

Scenarios.Scenario: Serve an inline completion/next-edit request on a cache miss with PatchBased02UnifiedEagerness selected
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing provider gathers configured context, builds the prompt, debounces, and then makes one streaming chat request. Compared with PatchBased02Unified, the new strategy follows the same prompt sections, response parser, system prompt, zero base debounce, and unified-provider behavior; it adds only a fixed high/low aggressiveness tag when applicable.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Resolve enabled language-context providers and ignored-resource checks
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Existing enabled providers/items for one request; no strategy-specific provider or per-item call is added by the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: PatchBased02Unified traversed the same context path with the same configured context options.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Existing context gathering is bounded by the request debounce and precedes the model fetch when enabled.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Gather and rank neighboring open-document snippets
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing gather per request when neighbor context is enabled, over the existing neighbor-document set.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: PatchBased02Unified used the same inherited prompt options and neighbor-snippet path.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Existing prompt context work occurs before the network request; the changed strategy does not enable it or increase its input set.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Send one streaming chat completion request
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One request for an effective cache miss in the existing request lifecycle; no loop or additional request is introduced.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: PatchBased02Unified issued the same single streaming request after the same context and debounce path.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: This is the dominant existing latency boundary. The changed prompt differs by only a constant-sized aggressiveness tag and retains the same response format.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Prompt size continues to scale with the same clipped current file, recent documents, history, and optional context. The diff adds only a constant-sized tag, not another collection traversal or payload-sized copy beyond existing prompt assembly.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Existing request cancellation, dependent sharing, debounce, and streaming behavior remain unchanged. supportsUnifiedCompletions remains true, so the separate completions provider is suppressed exactly as for PatchBased02Unified rather than creating parallel model calls.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: On a cold miss the existing request runs once. Strategy-inherited cacheDelay, rebasedCacheDelay, mimic-ghost-text behavior, and unified capability are byte-for-byte the same configuration values as PatchBased02Unified.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed switch arms converge on the existing PatchBased02Unified branches and the shared config object preserves all latency/cache knobs.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Model response length can intentionally vary with the eagerness signal, but that is the strategy's product behavior and the client diff provides no evidence of an unintended request, serialization, or concurrency increase.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression: no new boundary, fan-out, hot-path collection work, or client-side latency mechanism is introduced.

Scenarios.Scenario: Serve a cached or rebased inline edit with PatchBased02UnifiedEagerness selected
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing cache lookup/rebase path serves the edit locally and computes the configured minimum display delay; no prompt construction or chat request is needed on a hit.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: One cache lookup and existing edit rebase per request; the strategy adds no cache entries or history-dependent retained state.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Existing dependent tracking and cancellation semantics are unchanged; no new timers or concurrent work are added.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Cold behavior is the normal single fetch described above. Warm cached edits retain cacheDelay 200 ms and rebasedCacheDelay 0 ms, identical to PatchBased02Unified; cache keys and invalidation are untouched.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the new strategy spreads the exact shared unified config consumed by the cache-delay path.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Actual hit rates are not established, but both hit and miss mechanisms are unchanged by the diff.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression: cache lifecycle, retention, and warm-path latency are unchanged.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all six changed files and their strategy-selection, prompt construction, provider-unification, network request, context, debounce, and cache call paths. The PR adds a constant-sized strategy variant and reuses the existing PatchBased02Unified performance configuration; no actionable performance regression or qualifying regression fix was found.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
